# Repository reference

## Commands

| Command | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run start` | `HOST=0.0.0.0 react-scripts start` |
| `npm run build` | `react-scripts build` |
| `npm run test` | `react-scripts test` |
| `npm run eject` | `react-scripts eject` |
| `npm run validate` | `node scripts/validate-content.js` |
| `npm run screenshots` | `node scripts/capture-screenshots.js` |
| `npm run test:reading` | `node scripts/test-reading-features.js` |
| `npm run test:community` | `node scripts/test-community-features.js` |
| `npm run docs:generate` | `node scripts/automation/docs.cjs` |
| `npm run docs:check` | `node scripts/automation/docs.cjs --check` |
| `npm run test:database` | `node scripts/test-community-sql.cjs` |
| `npm run test:accessibility` | `node scripts/automation/accessibility.cjs` |
| `npm run test:live` | `node scripts/automation/smoke.cjs` |
| `npm run visual:capture` | `node scripts/automation/visual.cjs capture` |

## Browser configuration

These names are compiled into the browser bundle. Never use service-role keys or private credentials here.

- `REACT_APP_ALUMNI_ADMIN_EMAILS`
- `REACT_APP_ALUMNI_PREVIEW_INVITE_CODE`
- `REACT_APP_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
- `REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL`
